body:
docs/STALWART_PROVISIONING_REPORT.md: recommends Terraform for Cloudflare DNS records only (farthq.com already Cloudflare-managed, real token on file) and Ansible (agentless SSH) for on-box Stalwart install/config on the existing, already-live farthq.com Nanode -- explicitly answers 'yes, fully automatable, no manual login needed'. Named real missing pieces (box IP/hostname, SSH credential) and why this isn't Emily federated operations. Recommendation only, nothing deployed.

⚓ ☃
title: Wrote farthq.com Nanode provisioning report
